jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Hands-On, Product Engineering)
jobs.description:
REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We turn hundreds of pages of complex regulations, like MDR and FDA guidance, into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers' development and quality processes.
 We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.
 
 About the job
 We're growing from one engineering group into dedicated teams, and we're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead one of them: the team behind our core customer workflows, such as requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks and the AI agents that support regulatory and quality experts.
 This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a team of around six engineers, including product and ML engineers, and you'll stay close enough to the code to make good technical calls, review designs and step in when it matters. You won't be managing from the sidelines.
 You'll work closely with the team's product owner and designer, and report to the Head of Engineering.
 We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.
 
 What you'll do
 Own the team's outcomes. Make sure what the team ships works for customers: quality, reliability, delivery and the long-term health of the system.

 Lead and grow people. Run 1:1s, give direct feedback, help engineers grow their scope, and build a team where people hold outcomes, not tickets.

 Hire. Help us grow the team with people who raise the bar.

 Make delivery predictable. Work with product on priorities, own how the work is sequenced, and keep commitments to customers realistic and kept.

 Hold the gaps. Notice what falls between people, features and teams, such as dependencies nobody wrote down or incidents nobody picked up, and make sure someone owns them.

 Stay technical. Shape architecture with the team, review designs and code, and help debug the hard problems.

 Improve how we work. Bring structure where it helps and remove it where it doesn't, in an engineering organisation where agents are part of the daily development loop.

 What we're looking for
 Significant software engineering experience , with a strong technical background in building and running production systems, ideally in TypeScript.

 2+ years of managing engineers directly , including hiring, feedback and growing people.

 Experience leading delivery on a product team , working closely with product managers and designers.

 Strong technical depth. You stay close to the code, can review designs and implementations, debug complex issues, and make sound architectural trade-offs.

 Clear, direct communication , in writing and in conversation, including when things are going badly.

 High ownership. When something breaks for a customer, you treat it as yours to fix first and understand later.

 We'll be especially excited if you
 Have led a team shipping AI or LLM-based features to enterprise customers.

 Have worked in regulated or quality-heavy domains, where traceability and correctness matter.

 Have grown a team through a scaling phase, for example from Series A onwards.

 Have experience with ML engineers on your team, and know how to plan work where outcomes are uncertain.

jobs.description:
Role Summary 
 The Accelerating AI team's charter is broad and moving quickly. This role adds ownership depth where the portfolio needs it most. The specific assignment will be set at the offer stage based on portfolio priority, candidate strengths, and team fit. 
 Whichever surface you take, you own it end to end. You are expected to define the strategy, defend the sequencing, and answer for the results. 
 What You Will Do 
 Own Product strategy and roadmap for your surface. You are at the forefront of agentic security, defining the future of how security teams operate at scale. You’ll set clear priorities that drive your product from definition through launch. 

 Customer and partner discovery. Run design partner and MSP partner research sessions, separate signal from noise, and convert what you learn into roadmap decisions. Keep testing and revising that signal as usage data and customer feedback come in. 

 Shipped product. Lead 0-to-1 delivery against committed dates by working directly with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams. Make clear trade-offs, keep scope disciplined, and get the product into customer hands. 

 Adoption and engagement. Set and hit activation, usage, and retention targets. Run the experimentation program that moves those numbers. 

 Quality, safety, and trust. Partner with the Securing AI PM and the AI Safety Office so your surface meets Sophos's internal AI standards. Define and maintain the eval framework for your product. 

 Commercial readiness inputs. Supply requirements and evidence for packaging, licensing, and MSP/MSSP model decisions for your surface. Work with pricing, finance, sales, and other business teams so the commercial model reflects customer value and Sophos business goals. 

 Prototypes, not just specs. PMs on this team are expected to use AI tooling to test concepts, expose product risks, and make decisions more concrete before asking engineering to build. 

 Executive and field communication. Contribute to weekly updates, launch standups, QBR material, and enablement content. Brief executives and internal field audiences clearly and regularly. 

 What You Will Bring 
 5+ years of product management or related industry experience 

 Demonstrated track record building for expert users, with a strong intuition for delivering the right solution for the right problem at the right time 

 Direct, hands-on experience with the LLM product stack: RAG, prompt engineering, evals, model selection trade-offs, latency versus quality decisions, and hallucination mitigation. 

 Strong instincts for what makes AI features get used versus abandoned. You have opinions on onboarding, default behaviors, engagement expansion, and correcting the failure modes that erode trust. 

 Executive-grade written and verbal communication. This team operates in a tight loop with the CEO, President, CTO, and other executives, and the ideal candidate will navigate the different stakeholders with ease. 

 Have hands-on experience driving action in ambiguous spaces. 

 Cybersecurity, security operations, IT operations, or observability product experience. 

 Hands-on experience with agentic systems: tool-calling, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, or similar. 

 Experience with AI governance, data loss prevention, or acceptable-use policy enforcement. 

 MSP or MSSP channel product experience, including multi-tenant and partner-delivered motions.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus 
 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

 A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

 As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
 Note 
 We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro 

 Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

 De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

 Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

 Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

 Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure.  Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel. 
 Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.
 
 De uitdaging 
 Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.
 
 Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.
 
 Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.
 
 Jouw plek 
 Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt.

 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen.

 Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré.

 PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré).

 Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen.

 Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen.

 Afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

 Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

 Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
jobs.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? 
 
 The Mission: 
 Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation. 
 You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you. 
 

 What you'll own 
 A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome. 

 Your first 90 days 
 Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table. 

 Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for. 

 Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first. 

 
 
 What we need from you 
 Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer. 

 Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind. 

 Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make. 

 Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts. 

 Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships. 

 Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing. 

 
 What We Offer You to Win 
 Compensation : Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

 Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

 True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

 Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

 Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

 Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

 Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

 
 At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. 
 Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. 
 
 Dans le cadre de notre stratégie produit, nous recherchons un Product Owner Senior pour la verticale Service Tertiaire & B2B. Cette verticale est stratégique : elle sert de socle commun à toutes les offres du Groupe. 
 Elle doit devenir l'un des moteurs des innovations qui vont changer la façon dont les entreprises détectent, qualifient et développent leurs opportunités commerciales. Elle alimente aussi les autres verticales d'Intescia (Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire) avec des capacités communes : connaissance des entreprises, détection d'opportunités, enrichissement de données et intelligence artificielle. 
 
 Votre mission : 
 En binôme avec le Product Manager de la verticale, vous transformez la vision et la roadmap en produits livrés, utilisés et créateurs de valeur. 
 Vous êtes le garant du backlog et le référent produit au quotidien des équipes de développement. Votre objectif : livrer de façon régulière des fonctionnalités de qualité, qui ont un vrai impact. 
 Les fonctionnalités que vous livrerez sur cette verticale seront réutilisées dans l'ensemble des offres d'Intescia. La qualité de conception, la modularité et la cohérence de l'expérience sont donc au cœur de votre rôle. 
 
 Vos activités :

 Prioriser le backlog en continu selon la valeur client, l'impact business, la faisabilité technique et la dette. 

 Garantir un backlog toujours prêt (« ready »), avec deux à trois sprints d'avance. 

 Animer la delivery 
 Être le référent produit des équipes Tech, Data et IA au quotidien : vous répondez aux questions, arbitrez et levez les blocages. 

 Animer ou contribuer aux rituels agiles : affinage, planification de sprint, revue, rétrospective. 

 Recetter les fonctionnalités et valider leur conformité avant mise en production. 

 Suivre les indicateurs de delivery (vélocité, délais de livraison, qualité) et contribuer à leur amélioration. 

 Livrer les fonctionnalités IA de nouvelle génération 
 Spécifier et livrer des fonctionnalités qui s'appuient sur les dernières avancées de l'intelligence artificielle : 
 Agents IA 

 Recherche conversationnelle 

 Qualification automatique des prospects 

 Recommandations intelligentes 

 Automatisation des tâches commerciales 

 Copilotes de prospection 

 Sales Engagement augmenté 

 Vous travaillez étroitement avec les équipes Data et IA pour cadrer les cas d'usage, définir les critères de qualité des modèles (pertinence, précision, explicabilité) et organiser l'expérimentation : prototypes, tests utilisateurs, déploiements progressifs . 

 Exploiter la richesse de la donnée Intescia 
 Concevoir des fonctionnalités qui valorisent concrètement les actifs data du Groupe : 
 marchés publics 

 projets privés 

 données entreprises

 données essentielles 

 données financières 

 signaux d'affaires 

 données ouvertes 

 enrichissements issus de l'IA 

 Vous veillez à la qualité, à la fraîcheur et à la bonne exposition de ces données dans les parcours utilisateurs. 
 Construire des briques transverses réutilisables 
 Vous travaillez avec les Product Owners et Product Managers des verticales Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire. Ensemble, vous spécifiez des composants, des API et des services communes autour de la recherche, du scoring, de la recommandation, des signaux d'affaires et de l'automatisation. 
 Vous gérez les dépendances entre équipes, assurez une documentation fonctionnelle de qualité et facilitez l'adoption de ces briques par les autres verticales. 
 Rester au plus près des utilisateurs 
 Participer aux entretiens utilisateurs, aux ateliers et aux tests d'usage avec les équipes Design et Customer Success.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. 
 As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 
 We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.
 
 ✨ Our values 
 Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: 
 Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

 Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. 

 Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 
 

 The role 🔍
 One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.
 You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.
 This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.
 
 The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
 You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo , our Chief Product Officer.
 
 How we work 🤖
 We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.
 We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.
 We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.
 What this means for you:
 Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

 Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

 Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.
 

 Team goals 🎯
 We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.
 Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.
 
 Your responsibilities 🖋️
 Own the verification product (50%) 
 Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

 Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

 Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

 Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

 Drive adoption and revenue (30%) 
 Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

 Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

 Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

 Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

 Set the quality bar for AI (20%) 
 Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

 Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

 Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

 You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.
 
 Your goals ⚡
 After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.
 After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with

What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.
  
 Your expedition: Product & Growth
  
 This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.
  
 While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers .
  
 The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager I - Fusus Mobile
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon

Axon's mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams and communities act with speed, clarity and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security and international agencies detect, assess and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors and location data into a unified operating picture. Mobile is where that picture meets the field. It's the phone in an officer's pocket, the screen in a patrol car, the device a security lead carries across a campus. We're building fast, dependable mobile experiences that put the right information in responders' hands wherever they are.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Fusus Mobile, you will define and lead the strategy and roadmap for how Fusus works on the move. Your goal is to make mobile a first-class surface of real-time operations, not a smaller copy of the web.

You'll own the Fusus mobile platform and its primary apps: the experiences officers, supervisors and security teams use to receive alerts, view livestreams, see who is nearby and coordinate response. You'll also own the foundations other Axon teams build on, so new capabilities reach mobile at the same time as web.

You'll lead our boldest bets on mobile: personalised, role-based experiences that adapt to each user, AI-assisted workflows in the field, and new form factors such as in-vehicle (CarPlay and Android Auto), tablets and wearables. Your work will help responders around the world act faster and stay safer, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Fusus Mobile product strategy and roadmap across iOS and Android
  • Define the mobile platform (shared components, navigation, notifications, identity) that lets other teams ship features on mobile alongside web
  • Lead personalised and role-based mobile experiences, using mobile as the proving ground before they move to web
  • Close the gap between mobile and web for core workflows such as alerts, livestreaming, maps and search
  • Make the apps dependable in the field: offline behaviour, poor connectivity, battery, background location and push
  • Partner with engineering (UK, U.S. and Romania) and design to plan, release and monitor mobile versions on a predictable cadence
  • Engage law enforcement and enterprise users in the field (ride-alongs, site visits, betas) to validate needs and test improvements
  • Use metrics and feedback to set priorities: daily active use, crash-free sessions, time from alert to action, app store ratings
  • Support go-to-market, training, enablement and rollout with Customer Success, Professional Services and Sales

What Success Looks Like

  • Responders reach for Fusus Mobile first because it is fast, reliable and built for how they work in the field
  • New Fusus capabilities launch on mobile at the same time as web
  • Personalised experiences help each user see what matters to their role, with less setup and less noise
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention and positive field feedback

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning native mobile products (iOS and Android)
  • Experience building products where speed, clarity and reliability directly affect outcomes
  • Strong grasp of mobile platform concepts: release management and app stores, push notifications, background location, offline sync, device and OS fragmentation
  • Familiarity with real-time data, live video, maps and geolocation, alerting, or IoT int

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ExTrac
 ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.
 Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai .
 
 The Role
 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.
 ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.
 
 What the job involves 
 Roadmap ownership 
 Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

 Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

 Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

 Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

 Discovery and definition 
 Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

 Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

 Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

 Product operations and delivery 
 Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

 Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

 Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

 Technical and data judgement 
 Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

 Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

 Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

 Research, validation and data 
 Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

 Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

 Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

 Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

 For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

 Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

 Working with AI: Co-Analyst 
 Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

 Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

 Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

 Raising the bar for product practice 
 Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

 Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB 
 Are you ready to make an impact in product marketing? As our Product Marketing Manager, you’ll shape messaging, drive strategy, and collaborate with a dynamic, international team to deliver innovative campaigns and customer-focused initiatives. Equipped with the tools, support, and freedom to own your work, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly expanding security and compliance market. Become the champion of our innovative multi-suite hybrid software solution.
 
 WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA 
 We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.
 
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 You establish and maintain compelling value propositions with supporting materials like messaging frameworks, website content, demo materials, and thought leadership.

 You manage product launches and up- and cross-sell campaigns, often built around regulatory milestones such as NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act or the EU AI Act.

 You collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Sales, Professional Services) to ensure GTM campaigns are leveraging the latest product value propositions and messaging.

 You translate complex regulation into clear, practical messages that show customers what it means for their business and how we help.

 You collect and analyse customer insights and data while sharing them widely across the organisation to help improve our Product-, Partner- and Go-To-Market strategy.

 You create onboarding and education materials, such as guides, product walkthroughs, that show how our platform and our experts work together, so customers know when the software guides them and when an expert steps in.

 You conduct detailed competitive and market analyses for product segments, guiding the product roadmap and creating sales-focused battlecards.

 You develop, maintain, and deliver sales enablement content and tools to empower the sales team.

 
 WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN 
 The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

 Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

 Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

 Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

 Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

 
 THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD 
 3+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.

 A clear understanding of the sales funnel and customer journey, and of how positioning, messaging and enablement improve conversion and win rates.

 Experience running product launches and go-to-market plans from start to finish, together with Product, Sales and other teams.

 Strong writing and presentation skills. You can explain complex topics, such as new regulations, in simple, practical terms for decision-makers.

 Experience with competitive intelligence and customer research, including interviews with customers and lost prospects.

 Fluent German and English (C1 or higher), written and spoken.

 Experience in security, privacy or compliance (for example ISO 27001, NIS2 or GDPR) is a plus.

 Experience in enabling channel partners and expansion motions is a plus.

 
 LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS: 
 No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
Our Mission 
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?
 Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.
 We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.
 The Role
 You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.
 Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.
 Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.
 You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.
 The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built.

 Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

 Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

 A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

 Bring consistency and rhythm. You help give the team a rhythm for how we plan and ship, so everyone knows what’s happening and when.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. These may include launching VPC in new regions, supporting new hardware generations, improving platform scalability and resilience, evolving service architecture, and delivering new customer-facing networking capabilities.

You will work closely with developers, engineering managers, technical leads and product managers of VPC and adjacent teams. You will turn broad product and technical objectives into executable programs, define outcomes and acceptance criteria, expose dependencies and trade-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and coordinate delivery through validation, rollout, and operational readiness.
 

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.
  2. A strong technical background: you should be able to participate meaningfully in discussions about cloud networking and distributed systems, understand system boundaries and failure modes, and challenge assumptions without needing to be the primary architect.
  3. Practical knowledge of networking fundamentals such as IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, routing, network isolation, NAT, firewalls and load balancing. You should be comfortable learning and reasoning about the architecture of a production cloud-networking platform.
  4. Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, facilitate decisions, and produce concise, actionable documentation.
  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams with different priorities and dependencies.
  6. Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify critical paths, manage risks, and adapt plans as requirements change.
  7. A practical, outcome-oriented approach and the ability to drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience building or operating public-cloud or other large-scale infrastructure.
  • Experience with VPCs, SDN, network virtualization, or Linux networking.
  • Experience leading programs focused on reliability, scalability, or operational improvement.
  • Experience designing lightweight planning, risk-management, or operational-readiness processes for engineering organizations.

 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite.

 Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

 Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie.

 Une expérience avérée de Product Manager , de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.description:
About Act 
 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 
 Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.
  
 About the Role

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join our mission 
 We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 
 We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.
 After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.
 Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.
 
 About the role 
 As a Technical Project Manager at Namespace, you'll drive technical projects from planning through execution, working closely with engineering teams to translate business goals into clear technical work, manage timelines and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned. You'll bring a strong technical background and experience working with software engineering and developer tools, allowing you to understand technical trade-offs, anticipate risks, and operate effectively alongside engineers.
 
 Our culture 
 We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.
  
 What you'll do 
 Translate high-level business goals into clear technical tasks and project plans for engineering teams

 Create and maintain project documentation, managing timelines, budgets, scope, resources, and day-to-day priorities

 Anticipate technical obstacles, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure appropriate testing and quality standards

 Keep engineering teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and company leadership aligned on progress, priorities, and roadblocks

 Manage technical vendors and suppliers as part of project delivery

 
 What we're looking for 
 Technical background with experience in software development, engineering, computer science, or a closely related field

 Proven experience managing technical projects, either in a dedicated technical project management role or as a significant part of an engineering or technical role

 Experience working closely with software engineering teams and a strong understanding of how engineering projects are planned, built, and shipped

 Familiarity with developer tools and modern software development workflows

 Ability to understand technical requirements, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks and translate them into clear project plans

 Strong ownership and ability to drive multiple stakeholders toward execution in a fast-moving environment

 
 You can expect: 
 Competitive salary and stock options

 Flexible working hours

 Market-leading parental leave

 
 Life at Namespace Labs: 
 We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

 We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

 We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
 
 The Role 
 Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products  from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.

Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.

This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio
